name: Carlos Drummond de Andrade
contribution: A Brazilian poet and writer, considered by some as the greatest Brazilian poet of all time.

checks.lead: Carlos Drummond de Andrade (Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈkaʁluz dɾuˈmõ dʒi ɐ̃ˈdɾadʒi]) (October 31, 1902 – August 17, 1987) was a Brazilian poet and writer, considered by some as the greatest Brazilian poet of all time.
